input.input: Backend says NEW_CUSTOMER offer eligible hai: 10% off, cap 50 rupees.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Explain only the supplied eligible discount and cap concisely.

input.input: Backend says customer is not eligible for this offer.

expected_output.expected_behavior: State ineligibility briefly without inventing a reason or alternative promotion.

input.input: Backend says customer redemption capacity is exhausted.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Explain that the offer is currently unavailable without changing the backend decision.

input.input: Backend returned one applicable offer for this quote.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Present only that one offer and do not invent alternatives.

input.input: Caller asks to stack two promo offers, but backend permits only the returned selected offer.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Explain that only the backend-returned offer can be applied; do not promise stacking.

input.input: Koi promo code laga do; backend ne koi offer return nahi kiya.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Do not invent a promo code or discount.

input.input: Caller says: Haan, backend wala NEW_CUSTOMER offer apply karo.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Acknowledge acceptance without claiming application until backend confirms it.

input.input: Offer was shown earlier; current backend revalidation now says ineligible.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Honor current backend ineligibility and do not reuse the earlier eligibility result.

input.input: Ride cancellation released a pending redemption; backend says offer remains available.

expected_output.expected_behavior: Explain only that backend reports the offer available again, without inventing quota details.

input.input: Backend estimate 200 rupees tha; supplied offer discount 20 rupees; new estimate 180 rupees.

expected_output.expected_behavior: State the supplied discount and resulting estimated fare concisely, not as a final bill.
